'''TriNebulon News''', sometimes stylized as '''''TriNebulon News''''', was a large media corporation.

==History==
One of their subsidiaries was [[Tri-Nebula Entertainment]]. It had its headquarters in the [[Column Commons]] District on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

Known TriNebulon News journalists included [[Andor Javin]] and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Yutsen]].

[[Millennium Entertainments]] had a shareholder interest in ''TriNebulon News''.<ref name="HSCS" />

Although TriNebulon News was not officially part of [[Imperial HoloVision]], it nonetheless was required to publish any stories that paint the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in a positive light as well as spreading only loyal sentiment, with the threat of punishment if they fail to do so.<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>

TriNebulon News was still active in [[41 ABY]], when it carried [[Tirs Maladane]]'s [[Wookiee World Horror Witness!|account]] of their actions aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']] at the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kashyyyk]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
